summary.name: SlidesAI
summary.one_liner: SlidesAI is an AI presentation generator that turns notes, documents, PDFs, prompts or a topic into slide decks inside Google Slides, PowerPoint, ChatGPT or its web app.
use_cases: Turn lecture notes into classroom slides
Build a thesis or assignment presentation from research notes
Create business meeting or investor decks quickly
Generate sales pitch decks and client presentations
Make on-brand decks from an existing PowerPoint template
summary.what_it_does: SlidesAI takes a topic, pasted notes, a script, or an attached document and generates a presentation. Before writing, it asks clarifying questions about slide count, audience, tone and language. It produces an editable outline that users can reorder and rewrite, then writes slide text and designs each slide in the chosen style. Users can import a PPTX template as a Brand Kit so decks use their colors, fonts, logo and layouts. Finished decks can be presented, shared as a link, or exported to PowerPoint or Google Slides.
notable: Works inside Google Slides, PowerPoint and ChatGPT as well as a web app
Brand Kit imports a PPTX template so output matches brand colors, fonts and logo
Asks clarifying questions and lets you edit the outline before slides are built
Exports native Google Slides and PowerPoint files
caveats: Free Basic plan is limited to 200 AI credits per month and 2,500 characters of input per presentation
Uploading PDF and Word documents and uploading custom fonts require the paid Pro or Premium plans
Page lists prices in USD exclusive of taxes; the page's own comparison table is self-reported by the vendor
